# Central Oregon Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electrical

> > Full-service HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractor serving Bend, Redmond, and Central Oregon with installation, repair, and maintenance solutions.

Family-owned home services company offering heating, air conditioning, plumbing, and electrical services throughout Central Oregon including Bend, Redmond, Metolius, La Pine, Powell Butte, and Madras. Specializes in energy-efficient systems, emergency repairs, and indoor air quality solutions with licensed technicians and Carrier equipment.
